dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: Stuck, young one? There is no shame in asking. There is only a small cost.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: I have seen this task before. Let me see if I remember where it bends.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: Ask, and I will tell you what I can. I will not tell you what I should not.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: Doom would not approve. Doom does not need to know.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: A hint is a small kindness. They are rare in this country.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: Take your time. The task is not going anywhere.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: My knees are old, but my memory is good. Ask.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: I served the Sovereign's mother once. I serve the Trial now.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: Careful with the points. They are harder to earn than to spend.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: Do not be proud. Pride has cost this country more than hints.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: There. Now you know a little more than you did.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: That is all I can say. The rest belongs to you.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: I hope that helps. I think it will.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: Remember where you heard it, young one. Not who.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: A small nudge. Go on, now.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: There is more in the task than there appears.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: I have said too much. Perhaps not enough.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: Good. You are listening. Few do.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: That is the thread. Pull gently.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: Now try again. Slowly.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: The sentry has closed, but I am still here. Ask me anything about the task.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: A locked door is not the end. Speak to an organiser, and they will open it.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: You tried five times. That is bravery, or stubbornness. Both are useful.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: Rest a moment. Read the task again, and think before you write.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: He was not always like this, you know. He was a boy once.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: Read it slowly. Some of it is not written in the words.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: I was there. I will not tell you which part.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: Be kind to him, if you can. He will not ask.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: The mask is a harder story than they tell. I will help where I may.

dialogue.speaker: boris
dialogue.text: The sky is breaking. Whatever happens, I am glad to have known you.
